defect_a_binding_not_authoritative.problem: --predict re-resolved source_matrix/manifests/checkpoint+calibration live, allowing drift after binding
defect_a_binding_not_authoritative.correction: PREDICTION_PLAN_BINDING.json is the sole authoritative execution source; verify_binding_unchanged requires exact equality with a read-only recomputation before --predict proceeds

defect_b_package_unverified_at_bind.correction: verify_target_feature_package_required raises unless present_on_this_host AND verified AND identity match; target_feature_package_identity_verified and target_label_access=0 recorded separately

defect_c_lockset_cannot_represent_seeded.problem: target_prediction.build_lockset rejects duplicate experiment_id, incompatible with 3-5 seeded rows per arm
defect_c_lockset_cannot_represent_seeded.correction: new row_id-keyed build_v2_prediction_lockset; legacy build_lockset left completely unchanged and never called by V2

defect_d_noprompt_identity_collapse.problem: variant = row.arm made C-R-LLM and C-R-NOPROMPT indistinguishable (both arm=LLM)
defect_d_noprompt_identity_collapse.correction: prediction_variant_id = row.experiment_id, used for prediction row variant, inference_config_hash, and per-row lock variant; arm kept separate

defect_e_weak_existing_result_validation.problem: an existing TARGET_PREDICTION_LOCK.json was re-reported without validation
defect_e_weak_existing_result_validation.correction: validate_existing_exploratory_prediction_result: identity/binding/hash/schema/lockset cross-check; BLOCKS on any mismatch, never recomputes or overwrites

defect_f_weak_partial_detection.problem: partial-result detection only counted prediction files
defect_f_weak_partial_detection.correction: _detect_partial_state checks both prediction files and per-row locks, plus the two asymmetric completion cases

defect_g_hardcoded_package_path.correction: package_root passed from the caller's verified protocol/binding path

defect_h_wrong_acer_definition.problem: mean(binary_error_A) - mean(binary_error_B) is a class-blind error rate, not ACER, wrong under unequal live/spoof counts

defect_i_seeds_overwritten.problem: video_id->error dict repeatedly .update()d across seeds sharing an arm, discarding replication evidence
defect_i_seeds_overwritten.correction: class_stratified_paired_bootstrap keeps every matched seed's decisions in a separate mapping, averaged only at the final delta_seed step

defect_j_holm_family_mis_specified.problem: family_size=4, undercounting E-H1's 3 pairs and E-H4's 2 pairs
defect_j_holm_family_mis_specified.correction: family_size=7, all seven atomic comparisons enter one Holm-Bonferroni family

class_stratified_paired_bootstrap.tie_handling: a replicate statistic exactly zero counts toward both tail probabilities (inclusive <=/>=)

tests.test_environment_note: pytest/torch/pyarrow/opencv-python-headless/pydantic installed into an isolated project-local virtualenv for this session only; no scientific artifact produced; no GPU/CUDA package installed
